name: NV4097_SET_CONTEXT_DMA_VERTEX_B

name: NV4097_SET_CONTEXT_DMA_CULL_DATA

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_CLIP_HORIZONTAL

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_FORMAT

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_PITCH_A

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_COLOR_AOFFSET
metal4_target: guest-address identity for surface A (app address map -> MTL::Texture projection)
notes: Base offset for colour surface A (RSXThread.cpp:1444); identity is the app address map, not a Metal field (HLD-02 §2.5).

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_ZETA_OFFSET
metal4_target: guest-address identity for the depth surface (app address map -> MTL::Texture projection)
notes: Base offset for zeta (RSXThread.cpp:1468); paired with SET_CONTEXT_DMA_ZETA.

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_COLOR_BOFFSET
metal4_target: guest-address identity for surface B (app address map -> MTL::Texture projection)
notes: Base offset for colour surface B (RSXThread.cpp:1445); MRT only.

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_PITCH_B
metal4_target: MTLTextureDescriptor rowBytes (native_pitch) for surface B / memory_range
notes: Guest bytes/row for surface B; MRT only.

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_COLOR_TARGET

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_PITCH_Z
metal4_target: MTLTextureDescriptor rowBytes (native_pitch) for the depth surface / memory_range
notes: Guest bytes/row for zeta (RSXThread.cpp:1495); minimum-zeta-pitch correction can drop the surface (RSXThread.cpp:1644-1657).

name: NV4097_INVALIDATE_ZCULL
notes: Unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1303); filtered from the register dump (RSXThread.cpp:3198); no ZCULL cache on Metal and the visibility sink resets per pass (02 #33).

name: NV4097_SET_CYLINDRICAL_WRAP

name: NV4097_SET_CYLINDRICAL_WRAP1
notes: Unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1305); default 0x0; no reader.

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_PITCH_C
metal4_target: MTLTextureDescriptor rowBytes (native_pitch) for surface C / memory_range
notes: Guest bytes/row for surface C; MRT only.

notes: Guest bytes/row for surface D; MRT only.

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_COLOR_COFFSET

notes: Base offset for colour surface C (RSXThread.cpp:1446); MRT only.

name: NV4097_SET_SURFACE_COLOR_DOFFSET
metal4_target: guest-address identity for surface D (app address map -> MTL::Texture projection)
notes: Base offset for colour surface D (RSXThread.cpp:1447); MRT only.

name: NV4097_SET_WINDOW_OFFSET

notes: window_offset_x/y decode (rsx_decode.h:356-381); shifts each surface address by pitch*y + texel*x (RSXThread.cpp:1827-1852). [U] whether any live title uses a non-zero window offset against a resident RTT.

name: NV4097_SET_WINDOW_CLIP_TYPE
notes: Unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1315); any non-zero value is logged as unknown (RSXThread.cpp:1837-1838); no behavioural effect.

name: NV4097_SET_WINDOW_CLIP_HORIZONTAL
notes: Unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1316); read only to warn when it is smaller than the surface clip (RSXThread.cpp:1855-1860); never applied. [U] whether any title relies on it.

name: NV4097_SET_WINDOW_CLIP_VERTICAL
notes: Unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1317); read only for the same diagnostic; never applied. [U] as above.

name: NV4097_SET_DITHER_ENABLE
metal4_target: none (no Metal dither state; dropped as in the VK path)
notes: Decoder dither_enabled() (rsx_decode.h:782); reset default 0x1 (rsx_methods.cpp:357,994); unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1332). GL maps GL_DITHER (GLDraw.cpp:81), VK ignores it. Fixed-function dither is legacy and produces no guest-observable output under RSX-first; recommend dropping rather than a shader dither (a trap).

name: NV4097_SET_ALPHA_TEST_ENABLE
metal4_target: MSL discard in the ROP epilogue (RSXROPEpilogue.glsl); gated by RSX_SHADER_CONTROL_ALPHA_TEST
notes: Decoder (rsx_decode.h:667); state_signal fragment_program_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:722); alpha_test_enabled() also returns false for x32/w32z32y32x32 surfaces (rsx_methods.h:274-284). Metal has no fixed-function alpha test.

name: NV4097_SET_ALPHA_FUNC
metal4_target: ROP-control bits in the slot-3 fragment-state buffer; comparison_passes() in the ROP epilogue
notes: to_comparison_function (gcm_enums.h:1430); packed by rop_control.set_alpha_test_func (RSXDrawCommands.cpp:684-685); state_signal fragment_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:720).

name: NV4097_SET_ALPHA_REF
metal4_target: fragment_context_t.alpha_ref in the slot-3 fragment-state buffer
notes: 8/16/32-bit decode selected by surface format (rsx_decode.h:2575-2588; rsx_methods.h:749-761); state_signal fragment_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:721).

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_ENABLE
notes: Decoder (rsx_decode.h:805); blend_enabled_mask() ORs base bit 0 with BLEND_ENABLE_MRT (rsx_methods.h:493-497); state_signal pipeline_config_dirty + blend_config_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:780). Metal has no separate blend enable.

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_FUNC_SFACTOR
notes: rgb 0:16, a 16:32 (rsx_decode.h:2942-2962); bound to set_blend_factor with rollback (nv4097.cpp:619-635); all 15 blend_factor values map 1:1 to MTLBlendFactor (VKGSRender.cpp:137-159).

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_FUNC_DFACTOR
notes: rgb 0:16, a 16:32 (rsx_decode.h:2979-2999); bound to set_blend_factor with rollback (nv4097.cpp:619-635); 1:1 MTLBlendFactor.

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_COLOR
notes: 8b BGRA at 0/8/16/24 plus 16b RG (rsx_decode.h:3879-3907); combined with BLEND_COLOR2 by get_constant_blend_colors (rsx_utils.cpp:82-103); dynamic encoder state, VK parity vkCmdSetBlendConstants (VKDraw.cpp:180-185).

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_EQUATION
notes: rgb 0:16, a 16:32 (rsx_decode.h:2905-2925); 5 of 8 equations map 1:1; add_signed/reverse_add_signed/reverse_subtract_signed have no MTLBlendOperation and fall back to Add/Add/ReverseSubtract (VKGSRender.cpp:161-182); bound to set_blend_equation with rollback (nv4097.cpp:601-617).

name: NV4097_SET_COLOR_MASK
notes: A/R/G/B bits (rsx_decode.h:3009) -> MTLColorWriteMask; invalid values roll back to the latch (nv4097.cpp:349).

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_TEST_ENABLE
notes: Metal has no separate enable; a disabled test lowers to a passthrough stencil descriptor. Dirty-bit handler only (nv4097.cpp:333).

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_MASK
notes: Front-face write mask; unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1343) so the value is read straight from the register.

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_FUNC
notes: to_comparison_function (gcm_enums.h:1430); state signal pipeline_config_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:782).

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_FUNC_REF
notes: Front reference; dynamic encoder state, deliberately not in the depth-stencil object.

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_FUNC_MASK
notes: Front read mask.

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_OP_FAIL
notes: to_stencil_op (gcm_enums.h:1567); invalid values roll back (nv4097.cpp:366).

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_OP_ZFAIL
notes: Bound to set_stencil_op; same rollback path as the fail op.

name: NV4097_SET_STENCIL_OP_ZPASS
notes: Bound to set_stencil_op.

name: NV4097_SET_TWO_SIDED_STENCIL_TEST_ENABLE
notes: Disabled -> the back descriptor mirrors the front; Metal always carries both.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_MASK
notes: Back-face write mask.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_FUNC
notes: Back compare; unbound, read straight from the register.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_FUNC_REF
notes: Back reference; Metal's two-value setter carries both faces in one call.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_FUNC_MASK
notes: Back read mask.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_OP_FAIL
notes: Bound to set_stencil_op.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_OP_ZFAIL
notes: Bound to set_stencil_op.

name: NV4097_SET_BACK_STENCIL_OP_ZPASS
notes: Bound to set_stencil_op.

name: NV4097_SET_SHADE_MODE
metal4_target: MSL flat interpolation qualifier via RSX_SHADER_CONTROL_FLAT_SHADING; smooth fallback
notes: to_shading_mode (gcm_enums.h:1706); bound handler raises vertex + fragment program dirty (nv4097.cpp:728-743); flat emitted only when supports_last_provoking_vertex (RSXThread.cpp:2368-2373, 2415-2419). Metal exposes no public provoking-vertex mode, so it is false and the backend falls back to smooth (10 §2.2:109). [U] which titles regress under smooth.

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_ENABLE_MRT
notes: bits 1/2/3 = surface B/C/D (rsx_decode.h:3164-3177); combined with the base enable by blend_enabled_mask & 0xf (rsx_methods.h:493-497); state_signal pipeline_config_dirty + blend_config_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:781).

name: NV4097_SET_COLOR_MASK_MRT
notes: 4-bit group per RT index (rsx_decode.h:3064); A/R/G/B is bit 0/1/2/3 of each nibble; index maps to colour A..D.

name: NV4097_SET_LOGIC_OP_ENABLE
metal4_target: shader logic-op path selection over the ROP programmable-blend [[color(i)]] read-back
notes: Decoder (rsx_decode.h:759); state_signal pipeline_config_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:778); no Metal logic-op stage. Logic op takes precedence over blend when both are set (VKGSRender.cpp:322-326). [U] whether any live title depends on it.

name: NV4097_SET_LOGIC_OP
metal4_target: MSL bitwise logic over a [[color(i)]] fetch in the ROP epilogue
notes: 16 ops via to_logic_op (gcm_enums.h:1646); VK maps them to VkLogicOp (VKGSRender.cpp:112-135) but Metal has no equivalent. Fallback is framebuffer fetch + bitwise op, or drop at bring-up. [U] integer-vs-unorm semantics of the fetch.

name: NV4097_SET_BLEND_COLOR2
metal4_target: MTL4RenderCommandEncoder.setBlendColor (16-bit BA half of the constant colour)
notes: 16b B at 0:16, A at 16:32 (rsx_decode.h:3851-3859); read only for w16z16y16x16 surfaces (rsx_utils.cpp:85-92); default 0.

name: NV4097_SET_DEPTH_BOUNDS_TEST_ENABLE
metal4_target: MSL fragment discard in the depth-range epilogue (no MTLDepthStencil bounds)
notes: Metal has no depth-bounds test (VK gates on VK_DYNAMIC_STATE_DEPTH_BOUNDS, VKPipelineCompiler.cpp:114); fallback is a shader compare + discard. [U] whether any title relies on it.

name: NV4097_SET_DEPTH_BOUNDS_MIN
metal4_target: MTL4ArgumentTable.setAddress (fragment constant for the bounds compare)
notes: Bound value; reset default 0.0 (rsx_methods.cpp:351); consumed only by the shader fallback.

name: NV4097_SET_DEPTH_BOUNDS_MAX
metal4_target: MTL4ArgumentTable.setAddress (fragment constant for the bounds compare)
notes: Bound value; reset default 1.0 (rsx_methods.cpp:352).

name: NV4097_SET_CLIP_MIN
metal4_target: MSL apply_zclip_xform/apply_depth_range_xform (vertex-env buffer); MTLViewport.znear/zfar for the [0,1] subset
notes: f32 depth clip min (rsx_decode.h:1104); Metal has no depth-clip-range viewport param, so the general (extended) range is shader-emulated, mirroring VK _EMULATE_DEPTH_RANGE (RSXVertexPrologue.glsl:10,61); packed into the per-draw vertex env at buf+76 (VKGSRender.cpp:2138). [U] whether Apple float depth needs the shader transform at all.

name: NV4097_SET_CLIP_MAX
metal4_target: MSL apply_zclip_xform/apply_depth_range_xform (vertex-env buffer); MTLViewport.znear/zfar for the [0,1] subset
notes: f32 depth clip max (rsx_decode.h:1127); VK maps it to viewport maxDepth only when unrestricted depth range (VKGSRender.cpp:1311-1320), else the shader owns it; packed at buf+80; invalidate_zclip_bits (rsx_methods.cpp:718).

name: NV4097_SET_CONTROL0
notes: Only bit 12 depth_float is decoded (rsx_decode.h:4410) and drives surface_depth_fmt() (rsx_methods.h:937); remaining bits undecoded (LLD-misc Q1).

name: NV4097_SET_LINE_WIDTH
metal4_target: clamp to 1.0 (no setLineWidth); true width via host line-quad expansion
notes: decode (v>>3)+(v&7)/8 (rsx_decode.h:3259); Metal wideLines needs private API (README §6 R24); VK clamps unless wide_lines (VKDraw.cpp:175-177); default 0x8 = 1.0 (rsx_methods.cpp:361).

name: NV4097_SET_LINE_SMOOTH_ENABLE
metal4_target: host line-quad expansion with coverage alpha; default ignore (VK parity)
notes: unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1371); GL enables GL_LINE_SMOOTH (GLDraw.cpp:271), VK ignores it; no Metal line-smoothing state; default 0x0.

name: NV4097_SET_ANISO_SPREAD
notes: 16-word block; cellGcmInit default 0x01010101 (rsx_methods.cpp:277); never read - anisotropy comes from SET_TEXTURE_CONTROL0.max_aniso() (rsx_decode.h:4738).

name: NV4097_SET_SCISSOR_HORIZONTAL
notes: origin_x[0:16] width[16:16] (rsx_decode.h:114); intersected with the RSX viewport rect on draws (get_scissor clip_viewport, RSXThread.cpp:2115-2129); scissor is encoder dynamic state (HLD-04 §3.4).

name: NV4097_SET_SCISSOR_VERTICAL
notes: origin_y[0:16] height[16:16] (rsx_decode.h:142); same intersection; scissor_config_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:726-727).

name: NV4097_SET_FOG_MODE
notes: 6-mode fog equation selector; consumed only when the guest FP reads fogc (in_fogc); rides the fragment-state payload, no Metal state setter exists

name: NV4097_SET_FOG_PARAMS
notes: two f32 params spanning FOG_PARAMS and FOG_PARAMS+1; default 0.0; same slot-3 fragment_context field pair

name: NV4097_SET_SHADER_PROGRAM
metal4_target: MTL4::Library (SPIRV-Cross MSL) keyed by fragment ucode hash; MTL4::LibraryFunctionDescriptor entry
notes: Handler only raises fragment_program_ucode_dirty (nv4097.cpp:19); the 30-bit address feeds the ProgramStateCache ucode lookup, not a Metal object

name: NV4097_SET_VERTEX_TEXTURE_OFFSET
metal4_target: MTL::Texture via texture cache; MTL4ArgumentTable::setTexture(view, vertex_textures_first+id = 12+id)
notes: guest addr+location -> cache lookup; reuses the fragment-texture path

name: NV4097_SET_VERTEX_TEXTURE_FORMAT
metal4_target: MTLPixelFormat + MTLTextureType in texture cache; setTexture(12+id)
notes: format/dimension/cubemap select the cache entry; 4 VTF units (register stride 8)

name: NV4097_SET_VERTEX_TEXTURE_CONTROL0
notes: lod bias has no exact MSL sampler field -> shader-side injection

name: NV4097_SET_VERTEX_TEXTURE_IMAGE_RECT
notes: vertex-texture border always zero (RSXTexture.cpp:490)

name: NV4097_SET_VERTEX_TEXTURE_BORDER_COLOR
notes: only 3 fixed colours; custom -> closest

name: NV4097_SET_VIEWPORT_HORIZONTAL
metal4_target: MTLScissorRect intersection (RSX viewport rect); not the Metal viewport
notes: origin_x/width (rsx_decode.h:58); the Metal viewport is the surface clip, the RSX viewport rect only clips the scissor on draws (RSXThread.cpp:2117-2126); the transform is in scale_offset_mat (VKGSRender.cpp:1305).

name: NV4097_SET_VIEWPORT_VERTICAL
metal4_target: MTLScissorRect intersection (RSX viewport rect); not the Metal viewport
notes: origin_y/height (rsx_decode.h:86); same; scissor_config_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:728-729).

name: NV4097_SET_POINT_CENTER_MODE
notes: has_decoder=0; unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1390); no accessor and no consumer; point rasterization centre convention is fixed.

name: NV4097_ZCULL_SYNC
metal4_target: none (ZCULL sync hint; retirement owned by the sync model)
notes: Unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1391); filtered from the dump (RSXThread.cpp:3201); the flush is thread::sync() -> ZCULL_control::sync (RSXThread.cpp:2917).

name: NV4097_SET_VIEWPORT_OFFSET
metal4_target: scale_offset_mat in the per-draw vertex-env buffer (MTL4ArgumentTable.setAddress)
notes: f32 x/y/z/w (rsx_decode.h:1288); fill_scale_offset_data builds the NDC->window transform, not a Metal viewport (RSXDrawCommands.cpp:563-586); both VK and GL pass flip_y=false (VKGSRender.cpp:2134, GLGSRender.cpp:979).

name: NV4097_SET_VIEWPORT_SCALE
metal4_target: scale_offset_mat in the per-draw vertex-env buffer (MTL4ArgumentTable.setAddress)
notes: f32 x/y/z/w (rsx_decode.h:1196); same scale_offset_mat; vertex_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:732-737).

name: NV4097_SET_POLY_OFFSET_POINT_ENABLE
metal4_target: none - no Metal depth-bias path for point primitives; fallback ignore
notes: unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1400); VK honours only fill (VKDraw.cpp:212); GL enables GL_POLYGON_OFFSET_POINT (GLDraw.cpp:274); setDepthBias applies to triangles only; default 0x0.

name: NV4097_SET_POLY_OFFSET_LINE_ENABLE
metal4_target: none - no Metal depth-bias path for line primitives; fallback ignore
notes: unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1401); VK ignores it; GL enables GL_POLYGON_OFFSET_LINE (GLDraw.cpp:275); default 0x0.

name: NV4097_SET_POLY_OFFSET_FILL_ENABLE
notes: unbound (rsx_methods.cpp:1402); gates setDepthBias (VKDraw.cpp:212-239); polygon_offset_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:771).

name: NV4097_SET_DEPTH_FUNC
notes: to_comparison_function (gcm_enums.h:1430); reset default 0x201 (rsx_methods.cpp:354).

name: NV4097_SET_DEPTH_MASK
notes: Depth write enable.

name: NV4097_SET_DEPTH_TEST_ENABLE
notes: Metal has no separate enable; with the test off, writes stay governed by the depth mask.

name: NV4097_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET_SCALE_FACTOR
notes: f32 slope factor (rsx_decode.h:1150); polygon_offset_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:772); the NVIDIA D24 bias*0.5 hack (VKDraw.cpp:222-231) does not apply - D24 has no Apple-silicon format (README §4 shift 6).

name: NV4097_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET_BIAS
notes: f32 constant factor (rsx_decode.h:1173); polygon_offset_state_dirty (rsx_methods.cpp:773); same D24 note.

name: NV4097_SET_VERTEX_DATA_SCALED4S_M
metal4_target: transient MTL::Buffer attribute ring @ volatile stream slot 6
